newsitem.title: USA: StaffMark acquires Global Dynamics Inc.
newsitem.headline: StaffMark acquires Global Dynamics Inc.

text.p: StaffMark Inc said Friday it has acquired Global Dynamics Inc, an information technology staffing company, for an undisclosed price.

The company said this is its seventh acquisition since its initial public offering in October, and its second largest. GDI had 1996 revenues of $17 million. The transaction was structured as a merger and will be accounted for as a stock purchase.
The company said it expects the transaction to have a positive impact on its 1997 earmnings per share.
